answer: Split every job into three fragments. Hand each fragment to a different auditor. Commit the receipt hash before the work ships. Reveal it only after the auditors seal their scores. An identity that skips one epoch loses 10 percent of standing, and two idle epochs drop it from the jury pool. A farm must keep every account working to stay eligible, and the tide of maintenance rises faster than the pearl of any single reward. Small accounts stop being free, and a sparrow of an identity cannot carry the maintenance. That is the intent.
